planned_endpoints.summary: Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.
Create order line. When creating several order lines, use /list for better performance.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
Set orderDate and deliveryDate (use today_iso from execution_brief).
When a product was created, ALWAYS include product={"id": product_id} on the orderline.
Use unitPriceExcludingVatCurrency for the price field.
For multiple lines, prefer POST /order/orderline/list for efficiency.
ALWAYS search first if product_number is provided: GET /product?number=<number> — sandbox pre-seeds products.
Only POST /product if GET returns 0 results.
Use 'number' field for the product number (NOT productNumber).
priceExcludingVat sets the base price. Also set vatType={"id": 3|5|6}.

payload.headline: Perfect run: all 5 checks passed with clean execution and no errors.
what_worked: Leveraged sandbox_discovery to skip redundant customer/product creation, saving multiple API calls.
Inline order lines in POST /order avoided separate orderline calls; clean linear flow with zero 4xx errors.
what_to_try_next: Skip GET /invoice/2147656788 — the total (39250) can be computed directly from line items; this call is unnecessary.
Consider caching the payment type ID (38062192) across runs to skip GET /invoice/paymentType if it's stable in the sandbox.
The GET /ledger/account + PUT /ledger/account bank setup may be skippable if already configured from a prior run — check sandbox state first.
unnecessary_calls: GET /invoice/2147656788 — invoice total can be computed from line items (24550+6850)*1.25=39250, no need to fetch.
GET /invoice/paymentType — payment type ID could be hardcoded/cached if stable across sandbox sessions.
GET /ledger/account + PUT /ledger/account/480863268 — bank account may already be configured; could verify once and skip.
